plan.summary: This 4-week block is the first checkpoint of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the two main percentage-based lifts so future loading is accurate, and the main build starts in Week 2. With only 2 short S&C sessions per week, the plan stays full-body, power-first, then main strength, then a small amount of useful accessory work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower- and upper-body strength while keeping crisp jumps, throws, and basic speed work in the plan.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Push the main lifts and convert the new strength into stronger power outputs without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength with a lower dose and express faster, sharper boxing-relevant power and speed.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps and jump as high and fast as possible. Land quietly and keep every rep crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height that lets you land softly without tucking excessively.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Pause briefly at the bottom to remove the dip and keep the jump explosive.

exercises.notes: Use a non-bouncing ball. Turn through the hips and punch the throw hard without overreaching.

exercises.name: 2. Front Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up progressively, then work up to one hard top set of 3-5 reps. This sets your baseline for future percentage work, so choose the heaviest clean set you can complete with solid depth and posture.

substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if available and you want a stable upright squat pattern.
